comparison.objective: Candidate configures and verifies a gripper stop; PR-2019 scrapes griddle debris into a grease tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests precision coaxial tool seating and countertorque; PR-2019 tests sustained scraper angle, contact force, overlapping strokes, and debris control.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades lock retention and repeatable opening; PR-2019 grades debris mass transferred, residue left, spillage, gouging, and tool release.
comparison.reason: The objectives, force-control regimes, and observable products of the tasks are unrelated.
